rule: Every adverse result is retained with cause, repair, residual and next discriminator. A negative is not relabelled positive; a formal impossibility or identification theorem may be a positive scientific result.

entries.observation: V2 mapped 1335/1434 reference cells and missed 64 binary equivalence pairs.
entries.cause: Same-construct blocking and incomplete property signatures.
entries.repair: V3 full cross-construct enumeration mapped 1399/1399 binary equivalence pairs.
entries.residual: The repair was designed after public gold and used one bibliographic seed family.
entries.next_discriminator: Predeclare and replay the candidate-universe builder on source-disjoint families before reference access.

entries.observation: V2 lacked explicit terminals for non-binary relations, a missing reference member and out-of-domain cases.
entries.cause: The evaluator conflated unavailable truth with a closed-world negative.
entries.repair: V3 mapped 35 non-binary pairs, 2415 test-105 cases and 72941 out-of-domain cases to CANNOT_CHECK.
entries.residual: V3 still assigned within-domain reference omissions to OBSTRUCTION in a residual branch.
entries.next_discriminator: Require authoritative exhaustive-reference metadata or explicit negative truth; otherwise keep omissions set-valued.

entries.observation: The AML-plus-label predecessor had 304 V2 failures and 333 failures on the V3 scorable universe.
entries.cause: Correlated evidence channels and matcher nonselection were mistaken for an obstruction certificate.
entries.repair: V3 used the full binary envelope and V4 froze only the zero-failure AML=GLUE plus exact-label-equality cell.
entries.residual: The safe cell licenses positive GLUE only and selects 361/117914 cases.
entries.next_discriminator: Develop broadly covering input-native logical certificates; never use double-negative agreement as obstruction.

entries.observation: V3 coverage was 1.0 but harm was 0.25 in all three regimes, worse than AML by 0.224799430093, 0.224731584036 and 0.193522397680.
entries.cause: Every scorable output was the unresolved full envelope.
entries.repair: V4 derived the exact coverage-one selectivity formula H=0.25q.
entries.residual: The strictest conditional V3 comparator requires 89.919772% correct singleton selection, while the safe cell selects 0.306155%.
entries.next_discriminator: Obtain a broad prospectively valid positive or obstruction certificate and retest family-wise without pooling.

entries.observation: The V3 join contains 1399 explicit GLUE labels and 116515 OBSTRUCTION labels created in the residual within-domain absence branch.
entries.cause: A positive reference was treated as an exhaustive binary complement without source-level closure authority.
entries.repair: V4 proves open-world non-identification and forbids absence-derived obstruction.
entries.residual: Zero of seven audited OAEI family pages licenses absence as a binary negative; two KG tracks explicitly use partial gold.
entries.next_discriminator: Acquire explicit negative/disjointness annotations or an authoritative exhaustivity certificate over a frozen universe.

entries.observation: Seven official family pages were bound, but zero families had complete reference rights plus a cryptographic release identity; Biodiv returned HTTP 404.
entries.cause: Public reachability and citation instructions do not establish permission, exact upstream revision mapping or immutable reference identity.
entries.repair: A metadata-only rights and provenance matrix now identifies every missing receipt.
entries.residual: Zero eligible families versus three required.
entries.next_discriminator: Obtain provider permission/licences, exact upstream mappings and pre-outcome hashes for every selected input and reference.

entries.observation: Anatomy/LargeBio share NCI lineage; Conference/MultiFarm share OntoFarm; the metadata-only upper bound after definite collapse is five but the eligible count is zero.
entries.cause: Tracks, translations, nested subsets, pairs and languages were candidates for inflated replication credit.
entries.repair: V4 makes the source lineage/outcome-generating process the unit and records dependence collapses.
entries.residual: Family independence cannot be established without lawful exact releases and a frozen cluster design.
entries.next_discriminator: Freeze at least three rights-cleared source-lineage clusters and predeclare every dependence collapse.

entries.observation: Exact identities were bound for AML, LogMap and BERTMap, but zero comparators are execution-ready and strongest selection is unresolved.
entries.cause: Source identity alone does not fix dependencies, runtime, family support, parsers, resources, selective semantics or information equivalence.
entries.repair: A source-native comparator ledger now binds repositories, revisions, licences, entrypoints and fail-closed adapter rules.
entries.residual: Runtime closure and the family-specific scoring interface remain unfrozen; binary truth is independently unavailable.
entries.next_discriminator: Freeze and execute complete no-gold runtimes and positive-only adapters only after the source panel becomes eligible.

entries.observation: Seven families exhibit metadata-level source variation, but no family can be credited with both binary outcomes in comparable cases without opening outcomes.
entries.cause: Across-corpus variation was at risk of being mistaken for within-case discriminating opportunity.
entries.repair: The audit explicitly separates lineage variation from within-case binary separability.
entries.residual: Separability remains CANNOT_CHECK under the outcome-blind stop.
entries.next_discriminator: After a lawful pre-outcome freeze, audit outcome contrast within the predeclared comparable strata.

current_scientific_frontier: Build an authority-aware, rights-cleared multi-family benchmark in which positive and negative truth are actually identified, then test whether input-native certificates can cross the nearly 90% conditional selectivity requirement without a coverage failure.
